data.rationale: The proposal follows the true sequence (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then a mail draft with the same subject and body templates) and has the right parameters. However, it ends with a contradictory "Click Send" step instead of "do not send, click Discard", it has a redundant recipient_name/recipient_email split, it adds a "%" to the score, and it gives vague detail on the mail field clicks and tab switching, which makes automation somewhat risky.
